types.label: A decision waiting for you
types.description: Something needs your decision (a confirm, a model upgrade, a merge clash, a key, a pass …): one alert each; a tap opens it in the decision dialog; answering it clears it. Which kinds notify and which pop up are in Settings → Plugins → Decision dialog.

types.label: Decision dialog pops up
types.description: The decision dialog opening by itself on whatever console screen you are on. Per kind in Settings → Plugins → Decision dialog.
